data.content_ref: inline:The named relation is 'contradiction,' but the target never demonstrates a causal mechanism by which introducing a rubric eval form actually breaks or invalidates the program eval form. It asserts that the two eval forms 'require mutually exclusive assertion structures,' yet this is asserted as a surface-level incompatibility, not a demonstrated causal conflict — the target does not show why a single minimal fixture cannot carry both a rubric assertion and a typed assertion in separate test paths or composable assertion layers. The refutation condition even concedes this gap, asking whether the skeleton can 'simultaneously carry' both forms, which confirms the contradiction mechanism was never substantiated.
